Subject: Request to add LogStream Pty as subprocessor (Order Form / DPA)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. We're planning to engage LogStream Pty (Australia) to handle logs and metrics for our APAC customers. Per our MSA/Order Form we'll need Redwood's consent to add them as a subprocessor and to include a standard flow-down in the Order Form / DPA.

I've attached a redlined SOW and a draft subprocessor agreement for your review.

Key points:
- LogStream will process ingestion logs and anonymized metrics only (no raw customer PII).
- Expected start date: 2026-07-15.
- They will use AWS ap-southeast-2 (Sydney).
- We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report and a short network diagram.

Can you confirm the timelines and whether the flow-down language in our draft is sufficient, or whether Redwood needs additional clauses (e.g., 24h breach notice, audit rights)?

Attachments:
- APACcloud_LogStream_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
- LogStream_subproc_draft.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel

All —

I've reviewed the vendor draft and prepared a marked-up DPA annex and Order Form redline.

Key legal changes requested:
- Flow-down clause: require subprocessor to accept all data protection obligations in our DPA and permit Redwood to enforce rights directly.
- Audit: allow Redwood (or a third-party auditor) to audit subprocessor annually with reasonable notice.
- Breach notification: vendor must notify Redwood within 24 hours of becoming aware of a security incident affecting customer data.
- Data deletion: subprocessor must delete customer-identifiable logs within 90 days and certify deletion upon contract termination.

I've uploaded the redline here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDLINES (DocuSign-ready). Proposed DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-98765

If vendor accepts these, Procurement can issue the amendment and attach the DPA annex.

Markus Klein
